description: This file defines the LogView class which is a custom TextView used for displaying log data in an Android application. It implements the LogNode interface to process and output log messages in a readable format within the UI component.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView that outputs log data received through the LogNode interface, formatting and appending log messages to the UI.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats log data including priority, tag, message, and throwable, then updates the LogView UI and propagates to the next LogNode if set.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends a string as a new line in the LogView.
